Not everything is fighting. This quests only requires you to help with farm work.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
}}
* [[Zen Daijun]] ''not'' completed

===Objectives===
* Speak with [[Farmer Xeng Jo]].
* Kneel and plant [[Seeds|seeds]] in each of the farmer's fields.
* See [[Villager Hijai]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 75 [[Gold]]
* [[Monastery Credit]]

== Walkthrough ==
This is a relatively simple quest involving no fighting, and takes only about 1-2 minutes.

Use the [[emote]] /kneel to plant the seeds at each location.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
[[Human]]s
*{{x}} 10 (20) [[Farmer Xeng Jo]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Villager Hijai
:''"You are a hard person to find, <Character name>. Farmer Xeng Jo has been looking high and low for you since the first time you met in Sunqua Vale. Last I saw him, he was in [[Panjiang Peninsula]]. I would check there first."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = The farmer sent you to find me? Sounds important. I'll find him right away.
| decline = Farm work, eh? Did I mention that I have allergies? To manual labor, this is.
| ask = You still haven't found Farmer Xeng Jo? I believe that was him I just saw in [[Panjiang Peninsula]].
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Farmer Xeng Jo
:''"There you are, <Character name>. Planting season is upon us, but the farmers are already shorthanded. I need you to sow seeds to ensure that the island will bear enough food at harvest time. Here, take these seeds into the fields and kneel down to gently plant them just under the soil's surface. You know how to kneel, don't you?"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Villager Hijai
:''"Thank you for your help, <Character name>. Because of your efforts, I expect a full harvest when the time is ripe."''

===Alternate reward dialogue===
;Villager Hijai
:''"Oh, no. The rumor is true! The loss of farmer Xeng Jo will be detrimental, but his memory and spirit will live on in the hearts and minds of the citizens of Shing Jea Island."''

==Notes==
*Similar to [[Study Buddy]], if you completed the [[Zen Daijun]] mission with this quest in your [[Quest Log]], you can go accept the reward even though the quest objectives do not display as being completed.
